questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with VetPartners, VetLove and/or any other businesses operated by VetPartners.

Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if any clinics operated by VetPartners and VetLove are close competitors, if there are certain locations where there are few alternative clinics to VetPartners and VetLove, if there are certain services for which they are close competitors, or if any business operated by VetPartners or VetLove is a major supplier to competitors.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.

questions.section: Questions for owners and operators of veterinary clinics
questions.text: Describe the nature and level of competition in the local areas, city/region or state in which you operate (for example, the strength or number of competitors, and whether the nature and level of competition differs by the type of services offered). As a part of your response, describe whether there are certain areas in which the removal of VetLove as a competitor will have more of an impact on competition than others.

questions.section: Questions for owners and operators of veterinary clinics
questions.text: Explain how far pet owners are willing to travel to attend a veterinary clinic (and whether this varies by postcode or urban/regional areas), and what impacts their decision when choosing between alternative clinics (e.g. price, quality, service, location, or anything else).

questions.section: Questions for owners and operators of veterinary clinics
questions.text: Identify any factors that influence the establishment or expansion of veterinary clinics in Australia (e.g., obtaining a suitable premises and equipment, requirements for professional registration, large capital expenditure etc). As a part of your response, explain the estimated timeframes for the establishment or expansion of veterinary clinics in Australia.
